# Rakitsu tested build: v0.3.2 (09c37a8e)
name: Flood relief dispatch and replan
version: "1.0"
settings:
  default_provider: ollama
  providers:
    ollama:
      type: ollama
      base_url: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1
      default_model: qwen3:4b-q4_K_M
  defaults:
    temperature: 0
    max_tokens: 1800
tools:
  - name: intake_tool
    type: cli
    command: "python3 -I dispatch.py intake"
    description: "Reconcile duplicate shelter requests and road updates. No arguments."
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
  - name: plan_tool
    type: cli
    command: "python3 -I dispatch.py plan"
    description: "Produce a feasible allocation from the reconciled facts. No arguments."
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
  - name: verify_tool
    type: cli
    command: "python3 -I dispatch.py verify"
    description: "Verify the saved allocation and identify unmet needs for human review. No arguments."
    sandbox:
      type: local_restricted
      resource_limits: {timeout_sec: 10}
agents:
  - name: Intake
    role: worker
    tools: [intake_tool]
    system_prompt: "Call intake_tool with no arguments. Report the tool result. Reconcile duplicate shelter requests and road updates."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
  - name: Planner
    role: worker
    tools: [plan_tool]
    system_prompt: "Call plan_tool with no arguments. Report the tool result. Produce a feasible allocation from the reconciled facts."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
  - name: Verifier
    role: worker
    tools: [verify_tool]
    system_prompt: "Call verify_tool with no arguments. Report the tool result. Verify the saved allocation and identify unmet needs for human review."
    settings: {max_iterations: 3}
orchestrator:
  name: Dispatch
  strategy: Pipeline
  agents: [Intake, Planner, Verifier]
  pipeline:
    steps:
      - name: intake
        agent: Intake
        task: "Call intake_tool with {}. Reconcile duplicate shelter requests and road updates. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: intake_tool}
      - name: plan
        agent: Planner
        task: "Call plan_tool with {}. Produce a feasible allocation from the reconciled facts. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: plan_tool}
      - name: verify
        agent: Verifier
        task: "Call verify_tool with {}. Verify the saved allocation and identify unmet needs for human review. /no_think"
        require_tool_call: {tool: verify_tool}
